conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled; no forced cache flush or GC; input freezing and product builds precede measurement; each variant uses a new process and new DB
conditions.trials: 0 warmup pairs excluded, then 1 AB/BA pairs per dataset; with zero warmups the first order is AB. Each initial build supplies the identical pre-append state for that trial
conditions.timing: Product StageProfiler refresh through COMMIT/optimize; queries outside refresh; copy, process startup, DB open/migration, empty rollup activation, append, checks and source restoration excluded. Explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE entry through COMMIT return is additionally measured by a lightweight exec wrapper; BEGIN elapsed includes uncontended lock acquisition and is reported separately. Storage peer stages are ranked without nested summaries/rollups child timers.
conditions.queries: All pages and total group counts for provider and model bases, fixed 2026-01-01 inclusive to 2027-01-01 exclusive Asia/Seoul calendar bounds, excludeEmptyUsage=true, unknownTime=include, costs excluded; first post-refresh query per grouping/basis. Independent JS facts reducers also validate excludeEmptyUsage=false outside query timers.
conditions.instrumentation: Existing StageProfiler, logical source read wrappers and lightweight explicit BEGIN/COMMIT exec timestamps are identical in A and B; both variants use the same Worker pool and report its submission counts. Worker file stats are not intercepted; wrapper overhead is not separately calibrated
conditions.residual: Stage minus nested logical preparation wait; both A and B use the same Worker pool executing ahead in parallel, so this residual is coordinator overhead rather than Worker CPU time
conditions.metadataSqlCounters: Counts name INSERT/UPDATE, session billing SELECT and name pruning statement executions during refresh only; same prepare/run/get/all/iterate wrappers in both variants, overhead not calibrated
conditions.exclusions: UI, extension-host IPC, quota, heap/GC peak, adversarial error/cancellation/rewrite scenarios and independent real-log parser oracle not measured; source-worker IPC is included

correctness.independentRealDataParserOracle: not performed; synthetic totals checked against generator
